| Feature | **Free** | **Starter** | **Pro** ⭐ | **Ultimate** |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Zip code limit** | 20 | 500 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| **Searches/checks** | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| **Allowed zip codes** | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **Blocked zip codes** | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| **Zone organization** | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **ETA display** | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **COD availability** | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **Return policy display** | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **Widget customization** | Basic (text only) | Full (colors, text, position) | Full | Full |
| **Delivery rules** | No | **3 rules** (limited) | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| **Customer waitlist** | No | **View only** (25 entries max) | Full + bulk notify | Full + bulk notify |
| **CSV import** | No | **Import only** (up to 500) | Full import + export | Full import + export |
| **Cart blocking** | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| **Custom CSS** | No | No | No | Yes |
| **API access** | No | No | No | Yes |
| **Support** | Standard email | Email support | Priority email | 24/7 VIP |
| **Early access** | No | No | No | Yes |

### Psychology behind "limited access" on Starter:
- **3 delivery rules** — merchant sets up rules, sees the power, hits the limit, upgrades to Pro for unlimited
- **Waitlist view-only (25 entries)** — sees customer demand building up, can't bulk notify → upgrades to act on it
- **CSV import only (no export)** — can upload zips easily but can't export/backup → Pro unlocks full control
- This creates natural "aha moments" that drive upgrades without frustrating the merchant

---

## How We Beat Each Competitor

| vs Competitor | How we win |
|---|---|
| **vs Zipprover** | No search limits (they cap 500-2K), delivery rules included (they don't have it), $9.99 Pro vs their $12.99, waitlist at $4.99 (they charge $19.99) |
| **vs Zippy** | No search limits (they cap 750-2.5K), no zone limits, delivery rules + fees (they don't have it), $4.99 Starter vs $5.97 |
| **vs Smart Tracker** | No search limits (they cap 500-5K), delivery rules (they don't have it), ETA at $4.99 (they don't show ETA), $9.99 unlimited vs $14.99 |

# Pricing Restructure — 4-Tier Plan (Competitor-Beating)

## Context
The app currently has 3 tiers (Free / Pro $12.99 / Ultimate $24.99). The jump from $0 to $12.99 is too large for small merchants. We're adding a **Starter** tier and repricing all tiers to beat every competitor on both price AND value. The strategy uses "limited access" psychology — Starter gets a taste of advanced features (limited delivery rules, limited waitlist) so merchants see the value and upgrade naturally.

---

## Competitor Analysis

| App | Free | Tier 2 | Tier 3 | Tier 4 | Unique limits |
|-----|------|--------|--------|--------|---------------|
| **Zipprover** (5.0★, 40 reviews) | Basic, 1 rule, branding | $4.99 — 500 checks/mo, CSS | $12.99 — 1K checks, block ATC, product rules | $19.99 — 2K checks, ETA, waitlist | Limits monthly SEARCHES |
| **Zippy** (top competitor) | 1 zone, 750 searches | $5.97 — 3 zones, 2.5K searches | $15.97 — 10 zones, unlimited | -- | Limits zones + searches |
| **SB Zipcode Validator** | -- | $1.99 — unlimited zips, basic widget | -- | -- | Single plan, very basic |
| **Smart Zipcode Tracker** | 250 zips, 500 hits | $4.99 — 500 zips, 2K hits | $9.99 — 2K zips, 5K hits | $14.99 — unlimited | Limits zips + monthly hits |
| **MeroxIO Checker** | 10 zips | $4.99 — unlimited, analytics, ATC block | -- | -- | 2 tiers only |
| **Easy Zipcode (Avocados)** (5.0★, 33 reviews) | -- | $4.99 — unlimited zips | $7.99 — checkout block, CSS | $9.99 — waitlist, social proof | No free plan |

### Our Competitive Advantages (features NO competitor has)
1. **Delivery rules** with fees, cutoff times, delivery days, priority — UNIQUE
2. **No search/check limits** — we never charge per validation (competitors limit 500-2K/mo)
3. **COD availability + return policy display** — UNIQUE
4. **Social proof** (waitlist count on widget) — only Easy Zipcode has this at $9.99+
5. **Zone-based delivery fees** — only Zapiet does this but at enterprise pricing
6. **Cart + checkout blocking** — competitors charge $7.99-$12.99 for this

---

## New 4-Tier Pricing

| | **Free** | **Starter** | **Pro** ⭐ | **Ultimate** |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Monthly** | $0 | $4.99 | $9.99 | $19.99 |
| **Annual** | -- | $39/yr ($3.25/mo) | $79/yr ($6.58/mo) | $149/yr ($12.42/mo) |
| **Annual savings** | -- | 35% | 34% | 38% |
| **Trial** | -- | 7 days | 7 days | 7 days |

### Why this beats every competitor:
- **Starter $4.99** matches market entry price but gives WAY more value (delivery rules + waitlist access, which competitors charge $12.99-$19.99 for)
- **Pro $9.99** undercuts Zipprover ($12.99) and Zippy ($15.97) while offering unlimited everything
- **Ultimate $19.99** matches Zipprover's top tier but includes delivery rules, API, custom CSS — features they don't even have
- **Unlimited searches on ALL plans** — Zipprover caps at 500-2K/mo, Zippy caps at 750-2.5K, Smart caps at 500-5K

---

## Feature Matrix (Psychology: "limited access" on Starter)

| Feature | **Free** | **Starter** | **Pro** ⭐ | **Ultimate** |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Zip code limit** | 20 | 500 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| **Searches/checks** | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| **Allowed zip codes** | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **Blocked zip codes** | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| **Zone organization** | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **ETA display** | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **COD availability** | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **Return policy display** | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| **Widget customization** | Basic (text only) | Full (colors, text, position) | Full | Full |
| **Delivery rules** | No | **3 rules** (limited) | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| **Customer waitlist** | No | **View only** (25 entries max) | Full + bulk notify | Full + bulk notify |
| **CSV import** | No | **Import only** (up to 500) | Full import + export | Full import + export |
| **Cart blocking** | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| **Custom CSS** | No | No | No | Yes |
| **API access** | No | No | No | Yes |
| **Support** | Standard email | Email support | Priority email | 24/7 VIP |
| **Early access** | No | No | No | Yes |

### Psychology behind "limited access" on Starter:
- **3 delivery rules** — merchant sets up rules, sees the power, hits the limit, upgrades to Pro for unlimited
- **Waitlist view-only (25 entries)** — sees customer demand building up, can't bulk notify → upgrades to act on it
- **CSV import only (no export)** — can upload zips easily but can't export/backup → Pro unlocks full control
- This creates natural "aha moments" that drive upgrades without frustrating the merchant

---

## How We Beat Each Competitor

| vs Competitor | How we win |
|---|---|
| **vs Zipprover** | No search limits (they cap 500-2K), delivery rules included (they don't have it), $9.99 Pro vs their $12.99, waitlist at $4.99 (they charge $19.99) |
| **vs Zippy** | No search limits (they cap 750-2.5K), no zone limits, delivery rules + fees (they don't have it), $4.99 Starter vs $5.97 |
| **vs Smart Tracker** | No search limits (they cap 500-5K), delivery rules (they don't have it), ETA at $4.99 (they don't show ETA), $9.99 unlimited vs $14.99 |
| **vs SB Validator** | Full feature set vs their basic single-plan ($1.99 but extremely limited features) |
| **vs MeroxIO** | Delivery rules, waitlist, zones, ETA — all features they don't have |
| **vs Easy Zipcode** | We have a free plan (they don't), delivery rules (they don't), social proof at $4.99 starter level |

Add plan-based gating to `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`. Currently this route has NO plan gating.

The new gating rules:
- **Free plan**: 0 waitlist entries. Show locked Banner with upgrade CTA.
- **Starter plan**: Up to 25 waitlist entries. Can view but CANNOT use bulk notify. Show "X/25 entries" indicator.
- **Pro/Ultimate**: Unlimited waitlist, full access including bulk notify.

   - For "bulk-notify" intent: only allow if `limits.maxWaitlist === Infinity` (Pro+). Starter users can't bulk notify.

   - If `limits.maxWaitlist` is finite (25): show a limit indicator, hide bulk notify buttons
   - Import `PLAN_LIMITS` from `../plans`

The `PlanLimits` type is defined in `app/plans.ts` with fields including `maxWaitlist: number`.

- **Free**: Basic text customization only. Colors, position, and all toggle features are locked.
- **Starter**: Full widget customization (colors, text, position) + ETA/COD/return policy toggles. But NO cart blocking, NO custom CSS.

- **Ultimate**: Everything including custom CSS.

      - Gate behind `limits.customCss` (false on Free/Starter/Pro, true on Ultimate)
      - When locked: show the textarea as disabled with Badge "Ultimate"

1→/**
     2→ * Public API endpoint — serves widget configuration for the storefront block.
     3→ *
     4→ * Called from the theme app extension block JS to get the merchant's
     5→ * widget styling and text settings.
     6→ *
     7→ * GET /api/widget-config?shop=store.myshopify.com
     8→ *
     9→ * Response: WidgetConfig JSON (falls back to defaults if no config found)
    10→ */
    11→import type { LoaderFunctionArgs } from "react-router";
    12→import db from "../db.server";
    13→
    14→const CORS_HEADERS = {
    15→  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    16→  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, OPTIONS",
    17→  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type",
    18→  "Content-Type": "application/json",
    19→};
    20→
    21→const DEFAULTS = {
    22→  position: "inline",
    23→  primaryColor: "#008060",
    24→  successColor: "#008060",
    25→  errorColor: "#D72C0D",
    26→  backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
    27→  textColor: "#202223",
    28→  heading: "Check Delivery Availability",
    29→  placeholder: "Enter your zip code",
    30→  buttonText: "Check",
    31→  successMessage: "Great news! We deliver to your area.",
    32→  errorMessage: "Sorry, we don't deliver to this area yet.",
    33→  notFoundMessage: "This zip code was not found in our system.",
    34→  showEta: true,
    35→  showZone: false,
    36→  showWaitlistOnFailure: false,
    37→  blockCartOnInvalid: false,
    38→  blockCheckoutInCart: false,
    39→  showSocialProof: true,
    40→  borderRadius: "8",
    41→  customCss: null as string | null,
    42→};
    43→
    44→/**
    45→ * Sanitize merchant-supplied custom CSS before embedding it in a storefront
    46→ * <style> element. Strips known injection vectors:
    47→ *   - </style> close tags  — would break out of the enclosing style block
    48→ *   - @import directives   — would load arbitrary external stylesheets
    49→ *   - expression()         — IE-era JS-in-CSS execution vector
    50→ *   - javascript: URLs     — covers url(javascript:...) and similar
    51→ */
    52→function sanitizeCss(css: string): string {
    53→  return css
    54→    // Break out of <style> blocks
    55→    .replace(/<\/style>/gi, "")
    56→    // External stylesheet loading
    57→    .replace(/@import\b[^;]*(;|$)/gi, "")
    58→    // IE expression() — JS execution inside CSS property values
    59→    .replace(/\bexpression\s*\(/gi, "")
    60→    // javascript: protocol inside url() references
    61→    .replace(/url\s*\(\s*['"]?\s*javascript\s*:/gi, "url(");
    62→}
    63→
    64→export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
    65→  if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {
    66→    return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: CORS_HEADERS });
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  const url = new URL(request.url);
    70→  const shop = url.searchParams.get("shop");
    71→
    72→  if (!shop) {
    73→    return new Response(
    74→      JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing shop parameter" }),
    75→      { status: 400, headers: CORS_HEADERS },
    76→    );
    77→  }
    78→
    79→  // Validate shop is a real myshopify.com domain (prevents cross-shop config enumeration)
    80→  if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*\.myshopify\.com$/.test(shop) || shop.length > 100) {
    81→    return new Response(
    82→      JSON.stringify({ error: "Invalid shop parameter" }),
    83→      { status: 400, headers: CORS_HEADERS },
    84→    );
    85→  }
    86→
    87→  const config = await db.widgetConfig.findUnique({ where: { shop } });
    88→
    89→  const payload = config
    90→    ? {
    91→        position: config.position,
    92→        primaryColor: config.primaryColor,
    93→        successColor: config.successColor,
    94→        errorColor: config.errorColor,
    95→        backgroundColor: config.backgroundColor,
    96→        textColor: config.textColor,
    97→        heading: config.heading,
    98→        placeholder: config.placeholder,
    99→        buttonText: config.buttonText,
   100→        successMessage: config.successMessage,
   101→        errorMessage: config.errorMessage,
   102→        notFoundMessage: config.notFoundMessage,
   103→        showEta: config.showEta,
   104→        showZone: config.showZone,
   105→        showWaitlistOnFailure: config.showWaitlistOnFailure,
   106→        blockCartOnInvalid: config.blockCartOnInvalid ?? false,
   107→        blockCheckoutInCart: config.blockCheckoutInCart ?? false,
   108→        showSocialProof: config.showSocialProof ?? true,
   109→        borderRadius: config.borderRadius,
   110→        customCss: config.customCss ? sanitizeCss(config.customCss) : null,
   111→      }
   112→    : DEFAULTS;
   113→
   114→  return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), {
   115→    status: 200,
   116→    headers: {
   117→      ...CORS_HEADERS,
   118→      "Cache-Control": "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate",
   119→    },
   120→  });
   121→};

1→import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
     2→import type {
     3→  ActionFunctionArgs,
     4→  HeadersFunction,
     5→  LoaderFunctionArgs,
     6→} from "react-router";
     7→import { useFetcher, useLoaderData, useNavigate } from "react-router";
     8→import { useAppBridge } from "@shopify/app-bridge-react";
     9→import { authenticate } from "../shopify.server";
    10→import { boundary } from "@shopify/shopify-app-react-router/server";
    11→import { getShopSubscription } from "../billing.server";
    12→import { PLAN_LIMITS } from "../plans";
    13→import db from "../db.server";
    14→import {
    15→  Page,
    16→  Layout,
    17→  Card,
    18→  BlockStack,
    19→  InlineStack,
    20→  Text,
    21→  Badge,
    22→  Button,
    23→  Divider,
    24→  Box,
    25→  Select,
    26→  TextField,
    27→} from "@shopify/polaris";
    28→
    29→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    30→// Loader
    31→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    32→
    33→export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
    34→  const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request);
    35→  const shop = session.shop;
    36→
    37→  const [subscription, zipCount, shopSettings] = await Promise.all([
    38→    getShopSubscription(shop),
    39→    db.zipCode.count({ where: { shop } }),
    40→    db.shopSettings.findUnique({ where: { shop } }),
    41→  ]);
    42→
    43→  return {
    44→    subscription,
    45→    zipCount,
    46→    shop,
    47→    defaultBehavior: shopSettings?.defaultBehavior ?? "block",
    48→    notificationEmail: shopSettings?.notificationEmail ?? "",
    49→  };
    50→};
    51→
    52→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    53→// Action
    54→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    55→
    56→export const action = async ({ request }: ActionFunctionArgs) => {
    57→  const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request);
    58→  const shop = session.shop;
    59→
    60→  const formData = await request.formData();
    61→  const intent = formData.get("intent") as string;
    62→
    63→  try {
    64→    if (intent === "save-behavior") {
    65→      const defaultBehavior = formData.get("defaultBehavior") as string;
    66→      if (defaultBehavior !== "block" && defaultBehavior !== "allow") {
    67→        return { error: "Invalid value for defaultBehavior" };
    68→      }
    69→      await db.shopSettings.upsert({
    70→        where: { shop },
    71→        create: { shop, defaultBehavior },
    72→        update: { defaultBehavior },
    73→      });
    74→      return { success: true, intent };
    75→    }
    76→
    77→    if (intent === "save-notification") {
    78→      const notificationEmail =
    79→        (formData.get("notificationEmail") as string | null) ?? "";
    80→      await db.shopSettings.upsert({
    81→        where: { shop },
    82→        create: { shop, notificationEmail: notificationEmail || null },
    83→        update: { notificationEmail: notificationEmail || null },
    84→      });
    85→      return { success: true, intent };
    86→    }
    87→
    88→    return { error: "Unknown intent" };
    89→  } catch {
    90→    return { error: "Failed to save settings. Please try again." };
    91→  }
    92→};
    93→
    94→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    95→// Component
    96→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    97→
    98→export default function SettingsPage() {
    99→  const { subscription, zipCount, shop, defaultBehavior, notificationEmail } =
   100→    useLoaderData<typeof loader>();
   101→  const navigate = useNavigate();
   102→  const shopify = useAppBridge();
   103→  const limits = PLAN_LIMITS[subscription.planTier];
   104→
   105→  // Fetchers — one per save section so loading states stay independent
   106→  const behaviorFetcher = useFetcher<typeof action>();
   107→  const notificationFetcher = useFetcher<typeof action>();
   108→
   109→  // Local controlled state
   110→  const [behaviorValue, setBehaviorValue] = useState(defaultBehavior);
   111→  const [emailValue, setEmailValue] = useState(notificationEmail);
   112→
   113→  const isSavingBehavior = behaviorFetcher.state !== "idle";
   114→  const isSavingNotification = notificationFetcher.state !== "idle";
   115→
   116→  // Toast on success
   117→  useEffect(() => {
   118→    if (
   119→      behaviorFetcher.data &&
   120→      "success" in behaviorFetcher.data &&
   121→      behaviorFetcher.data.success
   122→    ) {
   123→      shopify.toast.show("Settings saved");
   124→    }
   125→  }, [behaviorFetcher.data, shopify]);
   126→
   127→  useEffect(() => {
   128→    if (
   129→      notificationFetcher.data &&
   130→      "success" in notificationFetcher.data &&
   131→      notificationFetcher.data.success
   132→    ) {
   133→      shopify.toast.show("Settings saved");
   134→    }
   135→  }, [notificationFetcher.data, shopify]);
   136→
   137→  const handleBehaviorChange = useCallback(
   138→    (value: string) => setBehaviorValue(value),
   139→    [],
   140→  );
   141→
   142→  const handleEmailChange = useCallback(
   143→    (value: string) => setEmailValue(value),
   144→    [],
   145→  );
   146→
   147→  const handleSaveBehavior = useCallback(() => {
   148→    const fd = new FormData();
   149→    fd.append("intent", "save-behavior");
   150→    fd.append("defaultBehavior", behaviorValue);
   151→    behaviorFetcher.submit(fd, { method: "post" });
   152→  }, [behaviorFetcher, behaviorValue]);
   153→
   154→  const handleSaveNotification = useCallback(() => {
   155→    const fd = new FormData();
   156→    fd.append("intent", "save-notification");
   157→    fd.append("notificationEmail", emailValue);
   158→    notificationFetcher.submit(fd, { method: "post" });
   159→  }, [notificationFetcher, emailValue]);
   160→
   161→  const behaviorOptions = [

   168→      value: "allow",
   169→    },
   170→  ];
   171→
   172→  const planBadgeTone =
   173→    subscription.planTier === "ultimate"

   178→
   179→  const planLabel =

   182→      : subscription.planTier === "pro"
   183→        ? "Pro"
   184→        : "Free";
   185→
   186→  return (
   187→    <Page
   188→      title="Settings"
   189→      subtitle="Manage your app settings and subscription"

   191→    >
   192→      <Box paddingBlockEnd="1600">
   193→        <Layout>
   194→
   195→          {/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   196→              Section 1: Subscription
   197→          ---------------------------------------------------------------- */}
   198→          <Layout.Section>
   199→            <Card>
   200→              <BlockStack gap="400">
   201→                <Text as="h2" variant="headingMd">
   202→                  Subscription
   203→                </Text>
   204→                <Divider />
   205→                <InlineStack align="space-between" blockAlign="center">
   206→                  <BlockStack gap="100">
   207→                    <Text as="p" variant="bodyMd">
   208→                      Current Plan
   209→                    </Text>
   210→                    <InlineStack gap="200" blockAlign="center">
   211→                      <Badge tone={planBadgeTone}>{planLabel}</Badge>
   212→                      {subscription.planTier !== "free" && (
   213→                        <Text as="span" tone="subdued" variant="bodySm">
   214→                          {subscription.billingInterval === "annual"
   215→                            ? "Billed annually"
   216→                            : "Billed monthly"}
   217→                        </Text>
   218→                      )}
   219→                      {subscription.planTier === "free" && (
   220→                        <Text as="span" tone="subdued" variant="bodySm">
   221→                          Limited features
   222→                        </Text>
   223→                      )}
   224→                    </InlineStack>
   225→                  </BlockStack>
   226→                  <Button
   227→                    variant="primary"
   228→                    onClick={() => navigate("/app/pricing")}
   229→                  >
   230→                    {subscription.planTier === "free"
   231→                      ? "Upgrade Plan"
   232→                      : "Manage Plan"}
   233→                  </Button>
   234→                </InlineStack>
   235→              </BlockStack>
   236→            </Card>
   237→          </Layout.Section>
   238→
   239→          {/* ----------------------------------------------------------------
   240→              Section 2: Default Behavior for Unknown Zip Codes (NEW)
   241→          ---------------------------------------------------------------- */}
   242→          <Layout.Section>
   243→            <Card>
   244→              <BlockStack gap="400">
   245→                <BlockStack gap="100">
   246→                  <Text as="h2" variant="headingMd">
   247→                    Default Behavior for Unknown Zip Codes
   248→                  </Text>
   249→                  <Text as="p" tone="subdued" variant="bodyMd">
   250→                    Choose what happens when a customer enters a zip code that
   251→                    is not in your list.
   252→                  </Text>
   253→                </BlockStack>
   254→                <Divider />
   255→                {behaviorFetcher.data &&
   256→                  "error" in behaviorFetcher.data &&
   257→                  behaviorFetcher.data.error && (
   258→                    <Text as="p" tone="critical" variant="bodyMd">
   259→                      {behaviorFetcher.data.error}
   260→                    </Text>
   261→                  )}
   262→                <Select
   263→                  label="Behavior for unlisted zip codes"
   264→                  options={behaviorOptions}
   265→                  value={behaviorValue}
   266→                  onChange={handleBehaviorChange}

   268→                <InlineStack align="start">

   284→

   299→                <Divider />
   300→                {notificationFetcher.data &&

   307→                <TextField

   315→                <InlineStack align="start">
